collection.title: The Criterion Collection
collection.description: A curated archive for world cinema, boxed sets, Eclipse discoveries, and director shelves.

archiveItems.title: Seven Samurai
archiveItems.summary: A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.
archiveItems.tagline: Unmatched for suspense and spectacle!

archiveItems.title: The 400 Blows
archiveItems.summary: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.
archiveItems.tagline: Angel faces hell-bent for violence.

archiveItems.title: Breathless
archiveItems.summary: A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he attempts to persuade a girl to run away to Italy with him.
archiveItems.tagline: Wild! Violent! Outspoken and Honest!

archiveItems.title: Playtime
archiveItems.summary: Clumsy Monsieur Hulot finds himself perplexed by the intimidating complexity of a gadget-filled Paris. He attempts to meet with a business contact but soon becomes lost. His roundabout journey parallels that of an American tourist, and as they weave through the inventive urban environment, they intermittently meet, developing an interest in one another. They eventually get together at a chaotic restaurant, along with several other quirky characters.
archiveItems.tagline: An incomparable spectacle.

archiveItems.title: Naked
archiveItems.summary: An unemployed Brit vents his rage on unsuspecting strangers as he embarks on a nocturnal London odyssey.
archiveItems.tagline: When unbalance leads to submission

archiveItems.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
archiveItems.summary: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.
archiveItems.tagline: Don't regret. Remember.

archiveItems.title: The Fly
archiveItems.summary: When brilliant, eccentric scientist Seth Brundle makes a huge technological breakthrough in teleportation, he decides to test it on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a common housefly manages to get inside the device and the two become one.
archiveItems.tagline: Be afraid. Be very afraid.

archiveItems.title: Videodrome
archiveItems.summary: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "Videodrome," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel. However, after his girlfriend auditions for the show and never returns, Max investigates the truth behind Videodrome and discovers that the graphic violence may not be as fake as he thought.
archiveItems.tagline: First it controls your mind. Then it destroys your body.

archiveItems.title: Naked Lunch
archiveItems.summary: Blank-faced bug killer Bill Lee and his dead-eyed wife, Joan, like to get high on Bill's pest poisons while lounging with Beat poet pals. After meeting the devilish Dr. Benway, Bill gets a drug made from a centipede. Upon indulging, he accidentally kills Joan, takes orders from his typewriter-turned-cockroach, ends up in a constantly mutating Mediterranean city and learns that his hip friends have published his work -- which he doesn't remember writing.
archiveItems.tagline: Exterminate all rational thought.

archiveItems.title: Rushmore
archiveItems.summary: When a beautiful first-grade teacher arrives at a prep school, she soon attracts the attention of an ambitious teenager named Max, who quickly falls in love with her. Max turns to the father of two of his schoolmates for advice on how to woo the teacher. However, the situation soon gets complicated when Max's new friend becomes involved with her, setting the two pals against one another in a war for her attention.
archiveItems.tagline: Love. Expulsion. Revolution.

archiveItems.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
archiveItems.summary: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.
archiveItems.tagline: A murder case of Madam D. with enormous wealth and the most outrageous events surrounding her sudden death!

archiveItems.title: Asteroid City
archiveItems.summary: In an American desert town circa 1955, the itinerary of a Junior Stargazer/Space Cadet convention is spectacularly disrupted by world-changing events.
archiveItems.tagline: "You can't wake up if you don't fall asleep"

archiveItems.title: The Seventh Seal
archiveItems.summary: When disillusioned Swedish knight Antonius Block returns home from the Crusades to find his country in the grips of the Black Death, he challenges Death to a chess match for his life. Tormented by the belief that God does not exist, Block sets off on a journey, meeting up with traveling players Jof and his wife, Mia, and becoming determined to evade Death long enough to commit one redemptive act while he still lives.
archiveItems.tagline: The story of a challenge to death.

archiveItems.title: Wild Strawberries
archiveItems.summary: Crotchety retired doctor Isak Borg travels from Stockholm to Lund, Sweden, with his pregnant and unhappy daughter-in-law, Marianne, in order to receive an honorary degree from his alma mater. Along the way, they encounter a series of hitchhikers, each of whom causes the elderly doctor to muse upon the pleasures and failures of his own life. These include the vivacious young Sara, a dead ringer for the doctor's own first love.

archiveItems.title: Persona
archiveItems.summary: A young nurse, Alma, is put in charge of Elisabeth Vogler: an actress who is seemingly healthy in all respects, but will not talk. As they spend time together, Alma speaks to Elisabeth constantly, never receiving any answer.
archiveItems.tagline: Ingmar Bergman's most personal and original film.

archiveItems.title: The Tale of Zatoichi
archiveItems.summary: The adventures of a blind, gambling masseur and master swordsman. Zatoichi targets a yakuza-controlled village, because war with a neighbouring town's smaller gang is brewing.

archiveItems.title: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
archiveItems.summary: Ichi travels to the village of Itakura to pay his respects at the grave of Kichizo, a man he killed two years ago. When some tax money is stolen while in transit to the governor he is accused and sets out to find the money and clear his name.

archiveItems.title: Zatoichi Goes to the Fire Festival
archiveItems.summary: The blind masseuse is targeted by the leader of a powerful yakuza group while also fending off a jealous husband bent on revenge. Zatoichi tours Edo's underground via a rousing onsen fight scene, gambling houses and the gender-bending character of Umeji, before a final, flame-filled conflagration.

archiveItems.title: Rashomon
archiveItems.summary: Four people recount different versions of the story of a man's murder and the rape of his wife.
archiveItems.tagline: The husband, the wife… or the bandit?

archiveItems.title: Ikiru
archiveItems.summary: Kanji Watanabe is a middle-aged man who has worked in the same monotonous bureaucratic position for decades. Learning he has cancer, he starts to look for the meaning of his life.
archiveItems.tagline: A big story of a little man which will grip your soul...

archiveItems.title: Thief
archiveItems.summary: Frank is an expert professional safecracker, specialized in high-profile diamond heists. He plans to use his ill-gotten income to retire from crime and build a nice life for himself complete with a home, wife and kids. To accelerate the process, he signs on with a top gangster for a big score.
archiveItems.tagline: Tonight, his take home pay is $410,000... tax free.

archiveItems.title: Risky Business
archiveItems.summary: Meet Joel Goodson, an industrious, college-bound 17-year-old and a responsible, trustworthy son. However, when his parents go away and leave him home alone in the wealthy Chicago suburbs with the Porsche at his disposal he quickly decides he has been good for too long and it is time to enjoy himself. After an unfortunate incident with the Porsche Joel must raise some cash, in a risky way.
archiveItems.tagline: There's a time for playing it safe and a time for Risky Business.

archiveItems.title: Sorcerer
archiveItems.summary: Four men from different parts of the globe, all hiding from their pasts in the same remote South American town, agree to risk their lives transporting several cases of dynamite (which is so old that it is dripping unstable nitroglycerin) across dangerous jungle terrain.
archiveItems.tagline: Four men...outlaws thrown together by fate...share a fantastic adventure and risk the only thing they have left to lose.

archiveItems.title: Paris Is Burning
archiveItems.summary: Where does voguing come from, and what, exactly, is throwing shade? This landmark documentary provides a vibrant snapshot of the 1980s through the eyes of New York City's African American and Latinx Harlem drag-ball scene. Made over seven years, PARIS IS BURNING offers an intimate portrait of rival fashion "houses," from fierce contests for trophies to house mothers offering sustenance in a world rampant with homophobia, transphobia, racism, AIDS, and poverty. Featuring legendary voguers, drag queens, and trans women — including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija, Dorian Corey, and Venus Xtravaganza.
archiveItems.tagline: Having a ball… Wish you were here

archiveItems.title: The Watermelon Woman
archiveItems.summary: A young black lesbian filmmaker probes into the life of The Watermelon Woman, a 1930s black actress who played 'mammy' archetypes.
archiveItems.tagline: Sometimes you have to create your own history.

archiveItems.title: House
archiveItems.summary: Hoping to find a sense of connection to her late mother, Gorgeous takes a trip with her friends to visit her aunt's ancestral house in the countryside. The girls soon discover that there is more to the old house than meets the eye.
archiveItems.tagline: In the heart of a violet forest, an old house awaits young girls.

archiveItems.title: Eyes Without a Face
archiveItems.summary: Dr. Génessier is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane, who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise, kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

cast.name: Yvette Etiévant
cast.role: Mother of the little sick man

archiveItems.tagline: The horror film with a heart of mystery.

archiveItems.title: Kuroneko
archiveItems.summary: In the Sengoku period, a woman and her daughter are raped and murdered by soldiers during a time of civil war. Afterwards, a series of samurai returning from the war through that area are found mysteriously dead with their throats torn out. The governor calls in a wild and fierce young hero to quell what is evidently an Onryō ghost.
archiveItems.tagline: Beware what lurks in the bamboo forest craving the blood of samurai!

archiveItems.title: Jules and Jim
archiveItems.summary: In the carefree days before World War I, introverted Austrian author Jules strikes up a friendship with the exuberant Frenchman Jim and both men fall for the impulsive and beautiful Catherine.
archiveItems.tagline: A Hymn to Life and Love

archiveItems.title: Cleo from 5 to 7
archiveItems.summary: Agnès Varda eloquently captures Paris in the sixties with this real-time portrait of a singer set adrift in the city as she awaits test results of a biopsy. A chronicle of the minutes of one woman’s life, Cléo from 5 to 7 is a spirited mix of vivid vérité and melodrama, featuring a score by Michel Legrand and cameos by Jean-Luc Godard and Anna Karina.

cast.name: Jean-Luc Godard
cast.role: The Man with Black Glasses / Actor in Silent Film

archiveItems.tagline: The whole world... has made an appointment with...

archiveItems.title: Bicycle Thieves
archiveItems.summary: Unemployed Antonio is elated when he finally finds work hanging posters around war-torn Rome. However on his first day, his bicycle—essential to his work—gets stolen. His job is doomed unless he can find the thief. With the help of his son, Antonio combs the city, becoming desperate for justice.
archiveItems.tagline: The Prize Picture They Want to Censor!

archiveItems.title: Rome, Open City
archiveItems.summary: During the Nazi occupation of 1944 Rome, Resistance leader Giorgio Manfredi is pursued by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a means of escape.
archiveItems.tagline: Our battle has barely begun.

archiveItems.title: Umberto D.
archiveItems.summary: When elderly pensioner Umberto Domenico Ferrari returns to his boarding house from a protest calling for a hike in old-age pensions, his landlady demands her 15,000-lire rent by the end of the month or he and his small dog will be turned out onto the street. Unable to get the money in time, Umberto fakes illness to get sent to a hospital, giving his beloved dog to the landlady's pregnant and abandoned maid for temporary safekeeping.

archiveItems.title: The Third Man
archiveItems.summary: In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "third man" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

cast.name: Alexis Chesnakov
cast.role: Col. Brodsky the Russian Liaison Officer (uncredited)

archiveItems.tagline: Hunted by men ... Sought by WOMEN!

archiveItems.title: Detour
archiveItems.summary: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.
archiveItems.tagline: He went searching for love… but fate forced a DETOUR to revelry… violence… mystery!

archiveItems.title: Night and the City
archiveItems.summary: Londoner Harry Fabian is a second-rate con man looking for an angle. After years of putting up with Harry's schemes, his girlfriend, Mary, becomes fed up when he taps her for yet another loan.
archiveItems.tagline: The inside story of London after dark.

archiveItems.title: Insomnia
archiveItems.summary: Detectives Jonas and Erik are called to the midnight sun country of northern Norway to investigate a recent homicide, but their plan to arrest the killer goes awry, and Jonas mistakenly shoots Erik. The suspect escapes, and a frightened Jonas pins Erik's death on the fugitive. Jonas continues to pursue the killer as he seeks to protect himself; however, his mounting guilt and the omnipresent sun plague him with an insomnia that affects his sanity.
archiveItems.tagline: No peace for the wicked

archiveItems.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
archiveItems.summary: Swedish thriller based on Stieg Larsson's novel about a male journalist and a young female hacker. In the opening of the movie, Mikael Blomkvist, a middle-aged publisher for the magazine Millennium, loses a libel case brought by corrupt Swedish industrialist Hans-Erik Wennerström. Nevertheless, he is hired by Henrik Vanger in order to solve a cold case, the disappearance of Vanger's niece
archiveItems.tagline: Based on the Worldwide Best Seller

archiveItems.title: Headhunters
archiveItems.summary: An accomplished headhunter risks everything to obtain a valuable painting owned by a former mercenary.
archiveItems.tagline: The hunt is on.

archiveItems.title: Bound
archiveItems.summary: Corky, a tough female ex-convict working on an apartment renovation in a Chicago building, meets a couple living next door, Caesar, a paranoid mobster, and Violet, his seductive girlfriend, who is immediately attracted to her.
archiveItems.tagline: For money. For murder. For each other.

archiveItems.title: Stranger by the Lake
archiveItems.summary: Franck spends his summer days hopelessly searching for companionship at a popular cruising spot on the shores of a lake in rural France. One day, he meets Michel, an attractive yet darkly mysterious man and falls blindly in love.

archiveItems.title: Knife+Heart
archiveItems.summary: In the summer of 1979, gay porn producer Anne sets out to film her most ambitious film yet, but her actors are picked off, one by one, by a mysterious killer.

archiveItems.title: Touki Bouki
archiveItems.summary: Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.
archiveItems.tagline: The Journey of the Hyena.

archiveItems.title: Redes
archiveItems.summary: A Mexican fisherman, whose son has died because he could not afford necessary medical care out of his meagre wages, becomes aware of how badly exploited he and his many fellow fisherman are by the one greedy man for whom they work and the corrupt politician who makes the laws to benefit him.

archiveItems.title: A River Called Titas
archiveItems.summary: An in-depth look at the lives and struggles of a fishing community living by the River Titas in Bangladesh after the Partition of India in 1947.

archiveItems.title: Dry Summer
archiveItems.summary: A scheming tobacco farmer sets out to ruin his competition by diverting the local water to his own property.

archiveItems.title: Trances
archiveItems.summary: A portrait of the groundbreaking Moroccan band Nass El Ghiwane, documenting a series of electrifying live performances in Tunisia, Morocco, and France; on the streets of Casablanca; and in intimate conversations. Storytellers through song and traditional instruments, and with connections to political theatre, the band became a local phenomenon and an international sensation, thanks to their rebellious lyrics and sublime, fully acoustic sound, which draws on Berber rhythms, Malhun sung poetry, and Gnawa dances.
archiveItems.tagline: Here at last comes the time of ecstasy, of trances.

archiveItems.title: The Housemaid
archiveItems.summary: A piano composer's family moves into a new house; when his pregnant wife collapses from working to support the family, he hires a housemaid to help with housework.
archiveItems.tagline: Do you have mine too?

archiveItems.title: Insiang
archiveItems.summary: A story about the life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila, which becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.

archiveItems.title: Mysterious Object at Noon
archiveItems.summary: A camera crew travels through Thailand asking villagers to invent the next chapter of an ever-growing story.

archiveItems.title: Revenge
archiveItems.summary: After another deadly shark attack, Ellen Brody decides she has had enough of New England's Amity Island and moves to the Caribbean to join her son, Michael, and his family. But a great white shark has followed her there, hungry for more lives.
archiveItems.tagline: This time it's personal.

archiveItems.title: Limite
archiveItems.summary: Adrift in the vast expanse of the ocean, a solitary boat carries three castaways—a man and two women. Stranded and devoid of any glimmer of rescue, they find solace in recounting the tales of their lives to one another. As they delve into their personal narratives, reminiscing about the circumstances that led them to this desolate predicament, they navigate through the depths of three distinct destinies. Bound by the confines of their shared space, every aspect of their existence becomes a boundary, underscoring their plight.
archiveItems.tagline: The urban entity versus the passion for the land

archiveItems.title: Law of the Border
archiveItems.summary: In Deliviran, a village near Urfa close to the Syrian border, Hidir’s chief is involved in smuggling and gets shot. Hidir tries to stay out of illegal activities but circumstances contrive to push him in the opposite direction until he accepts to take a herd of sheep across the border.

archiveItems.title: Taipei Story
archiveItems.summary: A young woman urgently seeks to navigate the maze of contemporary Taipei and find a future. She hopes that her boyfriend Lung is the key to the future, but Lung is stuck in a past that combines baseball and traditional loyalty that leads him to squander his nest egg bailing her father out of financial trouble.

archiveItems.title: Lucía
archiveItems.summary: Traces episodes in the lives of three Cuban women, each named Lucía, from three different historical periods: the 1890s, the 1930s, and the 1960s.

archiveItems.title: After the Curfew
archiveItems.summary: A hero of revolution returns to civilian life to find the new society very different from the ideals he fought for.

archiveItems.title: Pixote
archiveItems.summary: 10-year-old Pixote endures torture, degradation, and corruption at a local youth detention center where two of its members are murdered by policemen who frame Lilica, a 17-year-old trans hustler. Pixote helps Lilica and three other boys escape and they start to make their living by a life of crime which only escalates to more violence and death.
archiveItems.tagline: They can't outrun the law of the weakest.

archiveItems.title: Two Monks
archiveItems.summary: In a Gothic-styled monastery, a monk named Javier sees the face of another monk, Juan, and suddenly attempts to bludgeon him to death with a heavy crucifix. Both men then relate their own versions of a story of romantic rivalry between them.

archiveItems.title: Soleil Ô
archiveItems.summary: An educated native of Mauritania tries to find work in Paris but encounters difficulty because of his race.

archiveItems.title: Downpour
archiveItems.summary: Well-educated and humble teacher Mr Hekmati arrives in a new city and at a new job in the pre-revolutionary Iran. He falls in love with a hardworking underprivileged young woman who nurses her elderly mother and raises her young brother.

archiveItems.title: Sambizanga
archiveItems.summary: Domingos is a member of an African liberation movement, arrested by the Portuguese secret police, after bloody events in Angola. His wife goes from a prison station to another, trying in vain to find out where he is.

archiveItems.title: Prisoners of the Land
archiveItems.summary: Argentina, 1915. Accompanied by a doctor and his beautiful daughter, Köhner, a ruthless foreman who rules a yerba mate plantation with an iron fist, arrives in the city of Posadas with the purpose of hiring workers.

archiveItems.title: Chess of the Wind
archiveItems.summary: The first lady of a noble house has died and now there is conflict between the remainders for taking over her heritage.

archiveItems.title: Muna Moto
archiveItems.summary: Ngando and Ndomé share an extremely perfect love. Yet, tradition demands a dowry for Ndomé’s hand that Ngando, an orphan, cannot afford. Forced to ask his uncle for assistance, Ngando finds himself at the mercy of his uncle’s lust and greed. How can Ngando and Ndomé find peace together? Their journey will be challenging and everyone will learn that not everything special can be saved.

archiveItems.title: Two Girls on the Street
archiveItems.summary: Two girls run away from a small village. Gyöngyi comes from an aristocratic family and her father throws her out of the house when he discovers she has gotten pregnant out of wedlock. She finds herself wandering the streets of Budapest and earns money playing the violin in a restaurant. Vica is an orphaned peasant; she is afraid of her stepfather and moves to the city where she gets a job on a construction site. Gyöngyi and Vica meet on the streets of Budapest, move in together and turn their lives around.

archiveItems.title: Kalpana
archiveItems.summary: A writer goes to a film producer with a story in the hope of selling the idea for a film. As he explains it to the producer, scenes from his dance movie come to life.

archiveItems.title: Chronicle of the Years of Fire
archiveItems.posterUrl: ./assets/collections/criterion/world-cinema-project/5.1 Chronicle of the Years of Fire (1975).jpg
archiveItems.summary: A meticulous chronicle of the evolution of the Algerian national movement from 1939 until the outbreak of the revolution on November 1, 1954, the film unequivocally demonstrates that the "Algerian War" is not an accident of history, but a slow process of suffering and warlike revolts, uninterrupted, from the start of colonization in 1830, until this "Red All Saints' Day" of November 1, 1954. At its center, Ahmed gradually awakens to political awareness against colonization, under the gaze of his son, a symbol of the new Algeria, and that of Miloud, half-mad haranguer, half-prophet, incarnation of Popular memory of the revolt, the liberation of Algeria and its people.

archiveItems.title: Yam daabo
archiveItems.summary: Color UCLA Student Film, Preserved by the UCLA Film and Television Archive. Set in the present, the story takes place in Los Angeles. A foreign student from Taiwan , who is a great Chinese guitar player, arrives in the U.S. in the 70's. He decides to study nuclear engineering, but after graduation, he takes numerous menial jobs. The story begins when he receives a letter from his brother, notifying him of his visit from Taiwan. Exhaustedly, he tries to impress his brother by renting a new car and a new set of furniture. However, misfortune befalls him, as his house is robbed and he loses his job. For the first time, he is forced to think seriously about the meaning of his life in America.

archiveItems.title: Kummatty
archiveItems.summary: A stranger who may be the trickster magician Kummatty comes to a village in Malabar, India.
archiveItems.tagline: Kummatty will get you.

archiveItems.title: The Fall of Otrar
archiveItems.summary: A staggering historical epic about the intrigue and turmoil of the East Asian civilization of Otrar, before its systematic destruction at the hands of Genghis Khan.

worldCinemaProjectSets.title: World Cinema Project No. 1
worldCinemaProjectSets.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 1 gathers 6 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Touki Bouki
films.summary: Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

films.title: Redes
films.summary: A Mexican fisherman, whose son has died because he could not afford necessary medical care out of his meagre wages, becomes aware of how badly exploited he and his many fellow fisherman are by the one greedy man for whom they work and the corrupt politician who makes the laws to benefit him.

films.title: A River Called Titas
films.summary: An in-depth look at the lives and struggles of a fishing community living by the River Titas in Bangladesh after the Partition of India in 1947.

films.title: Dry Summer
films.summary: A scheming tobacco farmer sets out to ruin his competition by diverting the local water to his own property.

films.title: Trances
films.summary: A portrait of the groundbreaking Moroccan band Nass El Ghiwane, documenting a series of electrifying live performances in Tunisia, Morocco, and France; on the streets of Casablanca; and in intimate conversations. Storytellers through song and traditional instruments, and with connections to political theatre, the band became a local phenomenon and an international sensation, thanks to their rebellious lyrics and sublime, fully acoustic sound, which draws on Berber rhythms, Malhun sung poetry, and Gnawa dances.
films.tagline: Here at last comes the time of ecstasy, of trances.

films.title: The Housemaid
films.summary: A piano composer's family moves into a new house; when his pregnant wife collapses from working to support the family, he hires a housemaid to help with housework.

worldCinemaProjectSets.title: World Cinema Project No. 2
worldCinemaProjectSets.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 2 gathers 6 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Insiang
films.summary: A story about the life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila, which becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.

films.title: Mysterious Object at Noon
films.summary: A camera crew travels through Thailand asking villagers to invent the next chapter of an ever-growing story.

films.title: Revenge
films.summary: After another deadly shark attack, Ellen Brody decides she has had enough of New England's Amity Island and moves to the Caribbean to join her son, Michael, and his family. But a great white shark has followed her there, hungry for more lives.

films.title: Limite
films.summary: Adrift in the vast expanse of the ocean, a solitary boat carries three castaways—a man and two women. Stranded and devoid of any glimmer of rescue, they find solace in recounting the tales of their lives to one another. As they delve into their personal narratives, reminiscing about the circumstances that led them to this desolate predicament, they navigate through the depths of three distinct destinies. Bound by the confines of their shared space, every aspect of their existence becomes a boundary, underscoring their plight.
films.tagline: The urban entity versus the passion for the land

films.title: Law of the Border
films.summary: In Deliviran, a village near Urfa close to the Syrian border, Hidir’s chief is involved in smuggling and gets shot. Hidir tries to stay out of illegal activities but circumstances contrive to push him in the opposite direction until he accepts to take a herd of sheep across the border.

films.title: Taipei Story
films.summary: A young woman urgently seeks to navigate the maze of contemporary Taipei and find a future. She hopes that her boyfriend Lung is the key to the future, but Lung is stuck in a past that combines baseball and traditional loyalty that leads him to squander his nest egg bailing her father out of financial trouble.

worldCinemaProjectSets.title: World Cinema Project No. 3
worldCinemaProjectSets.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 3 gathers 6 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Lucía
films.summary: Traces episodes in the lives of three Cuban women, each named Lucía, from three different historical periods: the 1890s, the 1930s, and the 1960s.

films.title: After the Curfew
films.summary: A hero of revolution returns to civilian life to find the new society very different from the ideals he fought for.

films.title: Pixote
films.summary: 10-year-old Pixote endures torture, degradation, and corruption at a local youth detention center where two of its members are murdered by policemen who frame Lilica, a 17-year-old trans hustler. Pixote helps Lilica and three other boys escape and they start to make their living by a life of crime which only escalates to more violence and death.
films.tagline: They can't outrun the law of the weakest.

films.title: Two Monks
films.summary: In a Gothic-styled monastery, a monk named Javier sees the face of another monk, Juan, and suddenly attempts to bludgeon him to death with a heavy crucifix. Both men then relate their own versions of a story of romantic rivalry between them.

films.title: Soleil Ô
films.summary: An educated native of Mauritania tries to find work in Paris but encounters difficulty because of his race.

films.title: Downpour
films.summary: Well-educated and humble teacher Mr Hekmati arrives in a new city and at a new job in the pre-revolutionary Iran. He falls in love with a hardworking underprivileged young woman who nurses her elderly mother and raises her young brother.

worldCinemaProjectSets.title: World Cinema Project No. 4
worldCinemaProjectSets.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 4 gathers 6 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Sambizanga
films.summary: Domingos is a member of an African liberation movement, arrested by the Portuguese secret police, after bloody events in Angola. His wife goes from a prison station to another, trying in vain to find out where he is.

films.title: Prisoners of the Land
films.summary: Argentina, 1915. Accompanied by a doctor and his beautiful daughter, Köhner, a ruthless foreman who rules a yerba mate plantation with an iron fist, arrives in the city of Posadas with the purpose of hiring workers.

films.title: Chess of the Wind
films.summary: The first lady of a noble house has died and now there is conflict between the remainders for taking over her heritage.

films.title: Muna Moto
films.summary: Ngando and Ndomé share an extremely perfect love. Yet, tradition demands a dowry for Ndomé’s hand that Ngando, an orphan, cannot afford. Forced to ask his uncle for assistance, Ngando finds himself at the mercy of his uncle’s lust and greed. How can Ngando and Ndomé find peace together? Their journey will be challenging and everyone will learn that not everything special can be saved.

films.title: Two Girls on the Street
films.summary: Two girls run away from a small village. Gyöngyi comes from an aristocratic family and her father throws her out of the house when he discovers she has gotten pregnant out of wedlock. She finds herself wandering the streets of Budapest and earns money playing the violin in a restaurant. Vica is an orphaned peasant; she is afraid of her stepfather and moves to the city where she gets a job on a construction site. Gyöngyi and Vica meet on the streets of Budapest, move in together and turn their lives around.

films.title: Kalpana
films.summary: A writer goes to a film producer with a story in the hope of selling the idea for a film. As he explains it to the producer, scenes from his dance movie come to life.

worldCinemaProjectSets.title: World Cinema Project No. 5
worldCinemaProjectSets.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 5 gathers 4 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Chronicle of the Years of Fire
films.posterUrl: ./assets/collections/criterion/world-cinema-project/5.1 Chronicle of the Years of Fire (1975).jpg
films.summary: A meticulous chronicle of the evolution of the Algerian national movement from 1939 until the outbreak of the revolution on November 1, 1954, the film unequivocally demonstrates that the "Algerian War" is not an accident of history, but a slow process of suffering and warlike revolts, uninterrupted, from the start of colonization in 1830, until this "Red All Saints' Day" of November 1, 1954. At its center, Ahmed gradually awakens to political awareness against colonization, under the gaze of his son, a symbol of the new Algeria, and that of Miloud, half-mad haranguer, half-prophet, incarnation of Popular memory of the revolt, the liberation of Algeria and its people.
films.searchTitle: Chronicle of the Years of Fire
films.displayTitle: Chronicle of the Years of Fire
films.coverSourceName: 5.1 Chronicle of the Years of Fire (1975).jpg

films.title: Yam daabo
films.summary: Color UCLA Student Film, Preserved by the UCLA Film and Television Archive. Set in the present, the story takes place in Los Angeles. A foreign student from Taiwan , who is a great Chinese guitar player, arrives in the U.S. in the 70's. He decides to study nuclear engineering, but after graduation, he takes numerous menial jobs. The story begins when he receives a letter from his brother, notifying him of his visit from Taiwan. Exhaustedly, he tries to impress his brother by renting a new car and a new set of furniture. However, misfortune befalls him, as his house is robbed and he loses his job. For the first time, he is forced to think seriously about the meaning of his life in America.

films.title: Kummatty
films.summary: A stranger who may be the trickster magician Kummatty comes to a village in Malabar, India.

films.title: The Fall of Otrar
films.summary: A staggering historical epic about the intrigue and turmoil of the East Asian civilization of Otrar, before its systematic destruction at the hands of Genghis Khan.

jp-seven-samurai.title: Seven Samurai
jp-seven-samurai.summary: A samurai answers a village's request for protection after he falls on hard times. The town needs protection from bandits, so the samurai gathers six others to help him teach the people how to defend themselves, and the villagers provide the soldiers with food.

fr-400-blows.title: The 400 Blows
fr-400-blows.summary: For young Parisian boy Antoine Doinel, life is one difficult situation after another. Surrounded by inconsiderate adults, including his neglectful parents, Antoine spends his days with his best friend, Rene, trying to plan for a better life. When one of their schemes goes awry, Antoine ends up in trouble with the law, leading to even more conflicts with unsympathetic authority figures.

fr-breathless.title: Breathless
fr-breathless.summary: A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he attempts to persuade a girl to run away to Italy with him.

fr-playtime.title: Playtime
fr-playtime.summary: Clumsy Monsieur Hulot finds himself perplexed by the intimidating complexity of a gadget-filled Paris. He attempts to meet with a business contact but soon becomes lost. His roundabout journey parallels that of an American tourist, and as they weave through the inventive urban environment, they intermittently meet, developing an interest in one another. They eventually get together at a chaotic restaurant, along with several other quirky characters.

uk-naked.title: Naked
uk-naked.summary: An unemployed Brit vents his rage on unsuspecting strangers as he embarks on a nocturnal London odyssey.

fr-portrait.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
fr-portrait.summary: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

criterion-the-fly-1986.title: The Fly
criterion-the-fly-1986.summary: When brilliant, eccentric scientist Seth Brundle makes a huge technological breakthrough in teleportation, he decides to test it on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a common housefly manages to get inside the device and the two become one.

criterion-videodrome-1983.title: Videodrome
criterion-videodrome-1983.summary: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "Videodrome," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel. However, after his girlfriend auditions for the show and never returns, Max investigates the truth behind Videodrome and discovers that the graphic violence may not be as fake as he thought.
criterion-videodrome-1983.tagline: First it controls your mind. Then it destroys your body.

criterion-naked-lunch-1991.title: Naked Lunch
criterion-naked-lunch-1991.summary: Blank-faced bug killer Bill Lee and his dead-eyed wife, Joan, like to get high on Bill's pest poisons while lounging with Beat poet pals. After meeting the devilish Dr. Benway, Bill gets a drug made from a centipede. Upon indulging, he accidentally kills Joan, takes orders from his typewriter-turned-cockroach, ends up in a constantly mutating Mediterranean city and learns that his hip friends have published his work -- which he doesn't remember writing.

criterion-rushmore-1998.title: Rushmore
criterion-rushmore-1998.summary: When a beautiful first-grade teacher arrives at a prep school, she soon attracts the attention of an ambitious teenager named Max, who quickly falls in love with her. Max turns to the father of two of his schoolmates for advice on how to woo the teacher. However, the situation soon gets complicated when Max's new friend becomes involved with her, setting the two pals against one another in a war for her attention.

criterion-grand-budapest-hotel-2014.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
criterion-grand-budapest-hotel-2014.summary: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.
criterion-grand-budapest-hotel-2014.tagline: A murder case of Madam D. with enormous wealth and the most outrageous events surrounding her sudden death!

criterion-asteroid-city-2023.title: Asteroid City
criterion-asteroid-city-2023.summary: In an American desert town circa 1955, the itinerary of a Junior Stargazer/Space Cadet convention is spectacularly disrupted by world-changing events.
criterion-asteroid-city-2023.tagline: "You can't wake up if you don't fall asleep"

criterion-the-seventh-seal-1957.title: The Seventh Seal
criterion-the-seventh-seal-1957.summary: When disillusioned Swedish knight Antonius Block returns home from the Crusades to find his country in the grips of the Black Death, he challenges Death to a chess match for his life. Tormented by the belief that God does not exist, Block sets off on a journey, meeting up with traveling players Jof and his wife, Mia, and becoming determined to evade Death long enough to commit one redemptive act while he still lives.
criterion-the-seventh-seal-1957.tagline: The story of a challenge to death.

criterion-wild-strawberries-1957.title: Wild Strawberries
criterion-wild-strawberries-1957.summary: Crotchety retired doctor Isak Borg travels from Stockholm to Lund, Sweden, with his pregnant and unhappy daughter-in-law, Marianne, in order to receive an honorary degree from his alma mater. Along the way, they encounter a series of hitchhikers, each of whom causes the elderly doctor to muse upon the pleasures and failures of his own life. These include the vivacious young Sara, a dead ringer for the doctor's own first love.

criterion-persona-1966.title: Persona
criterion-persona-1966.summary: A young nurse, Alma, is put in charge of Elisabeth Vogler: an actress who is seemingly healthy in all respects, but will not talk. As they spend time together, Alma speaks to Elisabeth constantly, never receiving any answer.
criterion-persona-1966.tagline: Ingmar Bergman's most personal and original film.

criterion-the-tale-of-zatoichi-1962.title: The Tale of Zatoichi
criterion-the-tale-of-zatoichi-1962.summary: The adventures of a blind, gambling masseur and master swordsman. Zatoichi targets a yakuza-controlled village, because war with a neighbouring town's smaller gang is brewing.

criterion-zatoichi-and-the-chest-of-gold.title: Zatoichi and the Chest of Gold
criterion-zatoichi-and-the-chest-of-gold.summary: Ichi travels to the village of Itakura to pay his respects at the grave of Kichizo, a man he killed two years ago. When some tax money is stolen while in transit to the governor he is accused and sets out to find the money and clear his name.

criterion-zatoichi-goes-to-the-fire-fest.title: Zatoichi Goes to the Fire Festival
criterion-zatoichi-goes-to-the-fire-fest.summary: The blind masseuse is targeted by the leader of a powerful yakuza group while also fending off a jealous husband bent on revenge. Zatoichi tours Edo's underground via a rousing onsen fight scene, gambling houses and the gender-bending character of Umeji, before a final, flame-filled conflagration.

criterion-rashomon-1950.title: Rashomon
criterion-rashomon-1950.summary: Four people recount different versions of the story of a man's murder and the rape of his wife.
criterion-rashomon-1950.tagline: The husband, the wife… or the bandit?

criterion-ikiru-1952.title: Ikiru
criterion-ikiru-1952.summary: Kanji Watanabe is a middle-aged man who has worked in the same monotonous bureaucratic position for decades. Learning he has cancer, he starts to look for the meaning of his life.
criterion-ikiru-1952.tagline: A big story of a little man which will grip your soul...

criterion-thief-1981.title: Thief
criterion-thief-1981.summary: Frank is an expert professional safecracker, specialized in high-profile diamond heists. He plans to use his ill-gotten income to retire from crime and build a nice life for himself complete with a home, wife and kids. To accelerate the process, he signs on with a top gangster for a big score.
criterion-thief-1981.tagline: Tonight, his take home pay is $410,000... tax free.

criterion-risky-business-1983.title: Risky Business
criterion-risky-business-1983.summary: Meet Joel Goodson, an industrious, college-bound 17-year-old and a responsible, trustworthy son. However, when his parents go away and leave him home alone in the wealthy Chicago suburbs with the Porsche at his disposal he quickly decides he has been good for too long and it is time to enjoy himself. After an unfortunate incident with the Porsche Joel must raise some cash, in a risky way.
criterion-risky-business-1983.tagline: There's a time for playing it safe and a time for Risky Business.

criterion-sorcerer-1977.title: Sorcerer
criterion-sorcerer-1977.summary: Four men from different parts of the globe, all hiding from their pasts in the same remote South American town, agree to risk their lives transporting several cases of dynamite (which is so old that it is dripping unstable nitroglycerin) across dangerous jungle terrain.
criterion-sorcerer-1977.tagline: Four men...outlaws thrown together by fate...share a fantastic adventure and risk the only thing they have left to lose.

criterion-paris-is-burning-1990.title: Paris Is Burning
criterion-paris-is-burning-1990.summary: Where does voguing come from, and what, exactly, is throwing shade? This landmark documentary provides a vibrant snapshot of the 1980s through the eyes of New York City's African American and Latinx Harlem drag-ball scene. Made over seven years, PARIS IS BURNING offers an intimate portrait of rival fashion "houses," from fierce contests for trophies to house mothers offering sustenance in a world rampant with homophobia, transphobia, racism, AIDS, and poverty. Featuring legendary voguers, drag queens, and trans women — including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija, Dorian Corey, and Venus Xtravaganza.
criterion-paris-is-burning-1990.tagline: Having a ball… Wish you were here

criterion-the-watermelon-woman-1996.title: The Watermelon Woman
criterion-the-watermelon-woman-1996.summary: A young black lesbian filmmaker probes into the life of The Watermelon Woman, a 1930s black actress who played 'mammy' archetypes.
criterion-the-watermelon-woman-1996.tagline: Sometimes you have to create your own history.

criterion-house-1977.title: House
criterion-house-1977.summary: Hoping to find a sense of connection to her late mother, Gorgeous takes a trip with her friends to visit her aunt's ancestral house in the countryside. The girls soon discover that there is more to the old house than meets the eye.
criterion-house-1977.tagline: In the heart of a violet forest, an old house awaits young girls.

criterion-eyes-without-a-face-1960.title: Eyes Without a Face
criterion-eyes-without-a-face-1960.summary: Dr. Génessier is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane, who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise, kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

cast.name: Yvette Etiévant
cast.role: Mother of the little sick man

criterion-eyes-without-a-face-1960.tagline: The horror film with a heart of mystery.

criterion-kuroneko-1968.title: Kuroneko
criterion-kuroneko-1968.summary: In the Sengoku period, a woman and her daughter are raped and murdered by soldiers during a time of civil war. Afterwards, a series of samurai returning from the war through that area are found mysteriously dead with their throats torn out. The governor calls in a wild and fierce young hero to quell what is evidently an Onryō ghost.
criterion-kuroneko-1968.tagline: Beware what lurks in the bamboo forest craving the blood of samurai!

criterion-jules-and-jim-1962.title: Jules and Jim
criterion-jules-and-jim-1962.summary: In the carefree days before World War I, introverted Austrian author Jules strikes up a friendship with the exuberant Frenchman Jim and both men fall for the impulsive and beautiful Catherine.
criterion-jules-and-jim-1962.tagline: A Hymn to Life and Love

criterion-cleo-from-5-to-7-1962.title: Cleo from 5 to 7
criterion-cleo-from-5-to-7-1962.summary: Agnès Varda eloquently captures Paris in the sixties with this real-time portrait of a singer set adrift in the city as she awaits test results of a biopsy. A chronicle of the minutes of one woman’s life, Cléo from 5 to 7 is a spirited mix of vivid vérité and melodrama, featuring a score by Michel Legrand and cameos by Jean-Luc Godard and Anna Karina.

cast.name: Jean-Luc Godard
cast.role: The Man with Black Glasses / Actor in Silent Film

criterion-cleo-from-5-to-7-1962.tagline: The whole world... has made an appointment with...

criterion-bicycle-thieves-1948.title: Bicycle Thieves
criterion-bicycle-thieves-1948.summary: Unemployed Antonio is elated when he finally finds work hanging posters around war-torn Rome. However on his first day, his bicycle—essential to his work—gets stolen. His job is doomed unless he can find the thief. With the help of his son, Antonio combs the city, becoming desperate for justice.
criterion-bicycle-thieves-1948.tagline: The Prize Picture They Want to Censor!

criterion-rome-open-city-1945.title: Rome, Open City
criterion-rome-open-city-1945.summary: During the Nazi occupation of 1944 Rome, Resistance leader Giorgio Manfredi is pursued by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a means of escape.

criterion-umberto-d-1952.title: Umberto D.
criterion-umberto-d-1952.summary: When elderly pensioner Umberto Domenico Ferrari returns to his boarding house from a protest calling for a hike in old-age pensions, his landlady demands her 15,000-lire rent by the end of the month or he and his small dog will be turned out onto the street. Unable to get the money in time, Umberto fakes illness to get sent to a hospital, giving his beloved dog to the landlady's pregnant and abandoned maid for temporary safekeeping.

criterion-the-third-man-1949.title: The Third Man
criterion-the-third-man-1949.summary: In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "third man" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

cast.name: Alexis Chesnakov
cast.role: Col. Brodsky the Russian Liaison Officer (uncredited)

criterion-the-third-man-1949.tagline: Hunted by men ... Sought by WOMEN!

criterion-detour-1945.title: Detour
criterion-detour-1945.summary: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.
criterion-detour-1945.tagline: He went searching for love… but fate forced a DETOUR to revelry… violence… mystery!

criterion-night-and-the-city-1950.title: Night and the City
criterion-night-and-the-city-1950.summary: Londoner Harry Fabian is a second-rate con man looking for an angle. After years of putting up with Harry's schemes, his girlfriend, Mary, becomes fed up when he taps her for yet another loan.
criterion-night-and-the-city-1950.tagline: The inside story of London after dark.

criterion-insomnia-1997.title: Insomnia
criterion-insomnia-1997.summary: Detectives Jonas and Erik are called to the midnight sun country of northern Norway to investigate a recent homicide, but their plan to arrest the killer goes awry, and Jonas mistakenly shoots Erik. The suspect escapes, and a frightened Jonas pins Erik's death on the fugitive. Jonas continues to pursue the killer as he seeks to protect himself; however, his mounting guilt and the omnipresent sun plague him with an insomnia that affects his sanity.

criterion-the-girl-with-the-dragon-tatto.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
criterion-the-girl-with-the-dragon-tatto.summary: Swedish thriller based on Stieg Larsson's novel about a male journalist and a young female hacker. In the opening of the movie, Mikael Blomkvist, a middle-aged publisher for the magazine Millennium, loses a libel case brought by corrupt Swedish industrialist Hans-Erik Wennerström. Nevertheless, he is hired by Henrik Vanger in order to solve a cold case, the disappearance of Vanger's niece
criterion-the-girl-with-the-dragon-tatto.tagline: Based on the Worldwide Best Seller

criterion-headhunters-2011.title: Headhunters
criterion-headhunters-2011.summary: An accomplished headhunter risks everything to obtain a valuable painting owned by a former mercenary.

criterion-bound-1996.title: Bound
criterion-bound-1996.summary: Corky, a tough female ex-convict working on an apartment renovation in a Chicago building, meets a couple living next door, Caesar, a paranoid mobster, and Violet, his seductive girlfriend, who is immediately attracted to her.
criterion-bound-1996.tagline: For money. For murder. For each other.

criterion-stranger-by-the-lake-2013.title: Stranger by the Lake
criterion-stranger-by-the-lake-2013.summary: Franck spends his summer days hopelessly searching for companionship at a popular cruising spot on the shores of a lake in rural France. One day, he meets Michel, an attractive yet darkly mysterious man and falls blindly in love.

criterion-knife-heart-2018.title: Knife+Heart
criterion-knife-heart-2018.summary: In the summer of 1979, gay porn producer Anne sets out to film her most ambitious film yet, but her actors are picked off, one by one, by a mysterious killer.

criterion-world-cinema-project-1-01-touk.title: Touki Bouki
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-01-touk.summary: Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

criterion-world-cinema-project-1-02-rede.title: Redes
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-02-rede.summary: A Mexican fisherman, whose son has died because he could not afford necessary medical care out of his meagre wages, becomes aware of how badly exploited he and his many fellow fisherman are by the one greedy man for whom they work and the corrupt politician who makes the laws to benefit him.

criterion-world-cinema-project-1-03-a-ri.title: A River Called Titas
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-03-a-ri.summary: An in-depth look at the lives and struggles of a fishing community living by the River Titas in Bangladesh after the Partition of India in 1947.

criterion-world-cinema-project-1-04-dry-.title: Dry Summer
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-04-dry-.summary: A scheming tobacco farmer sets out to ruin his competition by diverting the local water to his own property.

criterion-world-cinema-project-1-05-tran.title: Trances
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-05-tran.summary: A portrait of the groundbreaking Moroccan band Nass El Ghiwane, documenting a series of electrifying live performances in Tunisia, Morocco, and France; on the streets of Casablanca; and in intimate conversations. Storytellers through song and traditional instruments, and with connections to political theatre, the band became a local phenomenon and an international sensation, thanks to their rebellious lyrics and sublime, fully acoustic sound, which draws on Berber rhythms, Malhun sung poetry, and Gnawa dances.
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-05-tran.tagline: Here at last comes the time of ecstasy, of trances.

criterion-world-cinema-project-1-06-the-.title: The Housemaid
criterion-world-cinema-project-1-06-the-.summary: A piano composer's family moves into a new house; when his pregnant wife collapses from working to support the family, he hires a housemaid to help with housework.

criterion-world-cinema-project-2-01-insi.title: Insiang
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-01-insi.summary: A story about the life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila, which becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.

criterion-world-cinema-project-2-02-myst.title: Mysterious Object at Noon
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-02-myst.summary: A camera crew travels through Thailand asking villagers to invent the next chapter of an ever-growing story.

criterion-world-cinema-project-2-03-reve.title: Revenge
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-03-reve.summary: After another deadly shark attack, Ellen Brody decides she has had enough of New England's Amity Island and moves to the Caribbean to join her son, Michael, and his family. But a great white shark has followed her there, hungry for more lives.

criterion-world-cinema-project-2-04-limi.title: Limite
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-04-limi.summary: Adrift in the vast expanse of the ocean, a solitary boat carries three castaways—a man and two women. Stranded and devoid of any glimmer of rescue, they find solace in recounting the tales of their lives to one another. As they delve into their personal narratives, reminiscing about the circumstances that led them to this desolate predicament, they navigate through the depths of three distinct destinies. Bound by the confines of their shared space, every aspect of their existence becomes a boundary, underscoring their plight.
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-04-limi.tagline: The urban entity versus the passion for the land

criterion-world-cinema-project-2-05-law-.title: Law of the Border
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-05-law-.summary: In Deliviran, a village near Urfa close to the Syrian border, Hidir’s chief is involved in smuggling and gets shot. Hidir tries to stay out of illegal activities but circumstances contrive to push him in the opposite direction until he accepts to take a herd of sheep across the border.

criterion-world-cinema-project-2-06-taip.title: Taipei Story
criterion-world-cinema-project-2-06-taip.summary: A young woman urgently seeks to navigate the maze of contemporary Taipei and find a future. She hopes that her boyfriend Lung is the key to the future, but Lung is stuck in a past that combines baseball and traditional loyalty that leads him to squander his nest egg bailing her father out of financial trouble.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3-01-luc-.title: Lucía
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-01-luc-.summary: Traces episodes in the lives of three Cuban women, each named Lucía, from three different historical periods: the 1890s, the 1930s, and the 1960s.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3-02-afte.title: After the Curfew
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-02-afte.summary: A hero of revolution returns to civilian life to find the new society very different from the ideals he fought for.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3-03-pixo.title: Pixote
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-03-pixo.summary: 10-year-old Pixote endures torture, degradation, and corruption at a local youth detention center where two of its members are murdered by policemen who frame Lilica, a 17-year-old trans hustler. Pixote helps Lilica and three other boys escape and they start to make their living by a life of crime which only escalates to more violence and death.
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-03-pixo.tagline: They can't outrun the law of the weakest.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3-04-two-.title: Two Monks
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-04-two-.summary: In a Gothic-styled monastery, a monk named Javier sees the face of another monk, Juan, and suddenly attempts to bludgeon him to death with a heavy crucifix. Both men then relate their own versions of a story of romantic rivalry between them.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3-05-sole.title: Soleil Ô
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-05-sole.summary: An educated native of Mauritania tries to find work in Paris but encounters difficulty because of his race.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3-06-down.title: Downpour
criterion-world-cinema-project-3-06-down.summary: Well-educated and humble teacher Mr Hekmati arrives in a new city and at a new job in the pre-revolutionary Iran. He falls in love with a hardworking underprivileged young woman who nurses her elderly mother and raises her young brother.

criterion-world-cinema-project-4-01-samb.title: Sambizanga
criterion-world-cinema-project-4-01-samb.summary: Domingos is a member of an African liberation movement, arrested by the Portuguese secret police, after bloody events in Angola. His wife goes from a prison station to another, trying in vain to find out where he is.

criterion-world-cinema-project-4-02-pris.title: Prisoners of the Land
criterion-world-cinema-project-4-02-pris.summary: Argentina, 1915. Accompanied by a doctor and his beautiful daughter, Köhner, a ruthless foreman who rules a yerba mate plantation with an iron fist, arrives in the city of Posadas with the purpose of hiring workers.

criterion-world-cinema-project-4-03-ches.title: Chess of the Wind
criterion-world-cinema-project-4-03-ches.summary: The first lady of a noble house has died and now there is conflict between the remainders for taking over her heritage.

criterion-world-cinema-project-4-04-muna.title: Muna Moto
criterion-world-cinema-project-4-04-muna.summary: Ngando and Ndomé share an extremely perfect love. Yet, tradition demands a dowry for Ndomé’s hand that Ngando, an orphan, cannot afford. Forced to ask his uncle for assistance, Ngando finds himself at the mercy of his uncle’s lust and greed. How can Ngando and Ndomé find peace together? Their journey will be challenging and everyone will learn that not everything special can be saved.

criterion-world-cinema-project-4-05-two-.title: Two Girls on the Street
criterion-world-cinema-project-4-05-two-.summary: Two girls run away from a small village. Gyöngyi comes from an aristocratic family and her father throws her out of the house when he discovers she has gotten pregnant out of wedlock. She finds herself wandering the streets of Budapest and earns money playing the violin in a restaurant. Vica is an orphaned peasant; she is afraid of her stepfather and moves to the city where she gets a job on a construction site. Gyöngyi and Vica meet on the streets of Budapest, move in together and turn their lives around.

criterion-world-cinema-project-4-06-kalp.title: Kalpana
criterion-world-cinema-project-4-06-kalp.summary: A writer goes to a film producer with a story in the hope of selling the idea for a film. As he explains it to the producer, scenes from his dance movie come to life.

criterion-world-cinema-project-5-01-chro.title: Chronicle of the Years of Fire
criterion-world-cinema-project-5-01-chro.posterUrl: ./assets/collections/criterion/world-cinema-project/5.1 Chronicle of the Years of Fire (1975).jpg
criterion-world-cinema-project-5-01-chro.summary: A meticulous chronicle of the evolution of the Algerian national movement from 1939 until the outbreak of the revolution on November 1, 1954, the film unequivocally demonstrates that the "Algerian War" is not an accident of history, but a slow process of suffering and warlike revolts, uninterrupted, from the start of colonization in 1830, until this "Red All Saints' Day" of November 1, 1954. At its center, Ahmed gradually awakens to political awareness against colonization, under the gaze of his son, a symbol of the new Algeria, and that of Miloud, half-mad haranguer, half-prophet, incarnation of Popular memory of the revolt, the liberation of Algeria and its people.

criterion-world-cinema-project-5-02-yam-.title: Yam daabo
criterion-world-cinema-project-5-02-yam-.summary: Color UCLA Student Film, Preserved by the UCLA Film and Television Archive. Set in the present, the story takes place in Los Angeles. A foreign student from Taiwan , who is a great Chinese guitar player, arrives in the U.S. in the 70's. He decides to study nuclear engineering, but after graduation, he takes numerous menial jobs. The story begins when he receives a letter from his brother, notifying him of his visit from Taiwan. Exhaustedly, he tries to impress his brother by renting a new car and a new set of furniture. However, misfortune befalls him, as his house is robbed and he loses his job. For the first time, he is forced to think seriously about the meaning of his life in America.

criterion-world-cinema-project-5-03-kumm.title: Kummatty
criterion-world-cinema-project-5-03-kumm.summary: A stranger who may be the trickster magician Kummatty comes to a village in Malabar, India.

criterion-world-cinema-project-5-04-the-.title: The Fall of Otrar
criterion-world-cinema-project-5-04-the-.summary: A staggering historical epic about the intrigue and turmoil of the East Asian civilization of Otrar, before its systematic destruction at the hands of Genghis Khan.

criterion-eclipse-01-port-of-call-1948.title: Port of Call

films.title: Touki Bouki
films.summary: Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

films.title: Redes
films.summary: A Mexican fisherman, whose son has died because he could not afford necessary medical care out of his meagre wages, becomes aware of how badly exploited he and his many fellow fisherman are by the one greedy man for whom they work and the corrupt politician who makes the laws to benefit him.

films.title: A River Called Titas
films.summary: An in-depth look at the lives and struggles of a fishing community living by the River Titas in Bangladesh after the Partition of India in 1947.

films.title: Dry Summer
films.summary: A scheming tobacco farmer sets out to ruin his competition by diverting the local water to his own property.

films.title: Trances
films.summary: A portrait of the groundbreaking Moroccan band Nass El Ghiwane, documenting a series of electrifying live performances in Tunisia, Morocco, and France; on the streets of Casablanca; and in intimate conversations. Storytellers through song and traditional instruments, and with connections to political theatre, the band became a local phenomenon and an international sensation, thanks to their rebellious lyrics and sublime, fully acoustic sound, which draws on Berber rhythms, Malhun sung poetry, and Gnawa dances.
films.tagline: Here at last comes the time of ecstasy, of trances.

films.title: The Housemaid
films.summary: A piano composer's family moves into a new house; when his pregnant wife collapses from working to support the family, he hires a housemaid to help with housework.

criterion-world-cinema-project-2.title: World Cinema Project No. 2
criterion-world-cinema-project-2.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 2 gathers 6 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Insiang
films.summary: A story about the life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila, which becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.

films.title: Mysterious Object at Noon
films.summary: A camera crew travels through Thailand asking villagers to invent the next chapter of an ever-growing story.

films.title: Revenge
films.summary: After another deadly shark attack, Ellen Brody decides she has had enough of New England's Amity Island and moves to the Caribbean to join her son, Michael, and his family. But a great white shark has followed her there, hungry for more lives.

films.title: Limite
films.summary: Adrift in the vast expanse of the ocean, a solitary boat carries three castaways—a man and two women. Stranded and devoid of any glimmer of rescue, they find solace in recounting the tales of their lives to one another. As they delve into their personal narratives, reminiscing about the circumstances that led them to this desolate predicament, they navigate through the depths of three distinct destinies. Bound by the confines of their shared space, every aspect of their existence becomes a boundary, underscoring their plight.
films.tagline: The urban entity versus the passion for the land

films.title: Law of the Border
films.summary: In Deliviran, a village near Urfa close to the Syrian border, Hidir’s chief is involved in smuggling and gets shot. Hidir tries to stay out of illegal activities but circumstances contrive to push him in the opposite direction until he accepts to take a herd of sheep across the border.

films.title: Taipei Story
films.summary: A young woman urgently seeks to navigate the maze of contemporary Taipei and find a future. She hopes that her boyfriend Lung is the key to the future, but Lung is stuck in a past that combines baseball and traditional loyalty that leads him to squander his nest egg bailing her father out of financial trouble.

criterion-world-cinema-project-3.title: World Cinema Project No. 3
criterion-world-cinema-project-3.summary: Martin Scorsese's World Cinema Project No. 3 gathers 6 restored films from the Criterion Collection.

films.title: Lucía
films.summary: Traces episodes in the lives of three Cuban women, each named Lucía, from three different historical periods: the 1890s, the 1930s, and the 1960s.

films.title: After the Curfew
films.summary: A hero of revolution returns to civilian life to find the new society very different from the ideals he fought for.

films.title: Pixote
films.summary: 10-year-old Pixote endures torture, degradation, and corruption at a local youth detention center where two of its members are murdered by policemen who frame Lilica, a 17-year-old trans hustler. Pixote helps Lilica and three other boys escape and they start to make their living by a life of crime which only escalates to more violence and death.
films.tagline: They can't outrun the law of the weakest.

films.title: Two Monks
films.summary: In a Gothic-styled monastery, a monk named Javier sees the face of another monk, Juan, and suddenly attempts to bludgeon him to death with a heavy crucifix. Both men then relate their own versions of a story of romantic rivalry between them.

films.title: Soleil Ô
films.summary: An educated native of Mauritania tries to find work in Paris but encounters difficulty because of his race.

films.title: Downpour
films.summary: Well-educated and humble teacher Mr Hekmati arrives in a new city and at a new job in the pre-revolutionary Iran. He falls in love with a hardworking underprivileged young woman who nurses her elderly mother and raises her young brother.

films.title: Sambizanga
films.summary: Domingos is a member of an African liberation movement, arrested by the Portuguese secret police, after bloody events in Angola. His wife goes from a prison station to another, trying in vain to find out where he is.

films.title: Prisoners of the Land
films.summary: Argentina, 1915. Accompanied by a doctor and his beautiful daughter, Köhner, a ruthless foreman who rules a yerba mate plantation with an iron fist, arrives in the city of Posadas with the purpose of hiring workers.

films.title: Chess of the Wind
films.summary: The first lady of a noble house has died and now there is conflict between the remainders for taking over her heritage.

films.title: Muna Moto
films.summary: Ngando and Ndomé share an extremely perfect love. Yet, tradition demands a dowry for Ndomé’s hand that Ngando, an orphan, cannot afford. Forced to ask his uncle for assistance, Ngando finds himself at the mercy of his uncle’s lust and greed. How can Ngando and Ndomé find peace together? Their journey will be challenging and everyone will learn that not everything special can be saved.

films.title: Two Girls on the Street
films.summary: Two girls run away from a small village. Gyöngyi comes from an aristocratic family and her father throws her out of the house when he discovers she has gotten pregnant out of wedlock. She finds herself wandering the streets of Budapest and earns money playing the violin in a restaurant. Vica is an orphaned peasant; she is afraid of her stepfather and moves to the city where she gets a job on a construction site. Gyöngyi and Vica meet on the streets of Budapest, move in together and turn their lives around.

films.title: Kalpana
films.summary: A writer goes to a film producer with a story in the hope of selling the idea for a film. As he explains it to the producer, scenes from his dance movie come to life.

films.title: Chronicle of the Years of Fire
films.posterUrl: ./assets/collections/criterion/world-cinema-project/5.1 Chronicle of the Years of Fire (1975).jpg
films.summary: A meticulous chronicle of the evolution of the Algerian national movement from 1939 until the outbreak of the revolution on November 1, 1954, the film unequivocally demonstrates that the "Algerian War" is not an accident of history, but a slow process of suffering and warlike revolts, uninterrupted, from the start of colonization in 1830, until this "Red All Saints' Day" of November 1, 1954. At its center, Ahmed gradually awakens to political awareness against colonization, under the gaze of his son, a symbol of the new Algeria, and that of Miloud, half-mad haranguer, half-prophet, incarnation of Popular memory of the revolt, the liberation of Algeria and its people.

films.title: Yam daabo
films.summary: Color UCLA Student Film, Preserved by the UCLA Film and Television Archive. Set in the present, the story takes place in Los Angeles. A foreign student from Taiwan , who is a great Chinese guitar player, arrives in the U.S. in the 70's. He decides to study nuclear engineering, but after graduation, he takes numerous menial jobs. The story begins when he receives a letter from his brother, notifying him of his visit from Taiwan. Exhaustedly, he tries to impress his brother by renting a new car and a new set of furniture. However, misfortune befalls him, as his house is robbed and he loses his job. For the first time, he is forced to think seriously about the meaning of his life in America.

films.title: The Fall of Otrar
